headline: JSW Dulux stock split: Last day to buy for eligibility
hook: Final chance for JSW Dulux split eligibility
summary: JSW Dulux has announced a 1:10 stock split, meaning shareholders will receive ten shares for every one currently held. Investors must purchase the stock by the record date to qualify for the split. This corporate action increases the number of outstanding shares while proportionally reducing the price per share. Retail investors should note that the split does not change the total value of their investment.
whats_next: Record date for the 1:10 stock split
why_it_matters: Increases share count and liquidity without changing total investment value.

headline: JSW Dulux reports pending litigations or disputes impacting the company
hook: Legal dispute disclosure from JSW Dulux
summary: JSW Dulux Limited has officially notified the stock exchange regarding the pendency of litigations or disputes that could have an impact on the company. Such regulatory filings are standard disclosure requirements for listed entities to maintain transparency with stakeholders. Legal outcomes may introduce volatility to the stock price depending on the financial magnitude of the disputes.
whats_next: Future regulatory filings on case developments
why_it_matters: Legal overhang may create short-term stock volatility for holders.

headline: Rajiv Lochan Jha resigns as Company Secretary of JSW Dulux
summary: JSW Dulux Limited has informed the stock exchange about the resignation of Mr Rajiv Lochan Jha from his position as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. headline: Four small-cap companies announce stock splits scheduled for October 2026
hook: Upcoming October split calendar for four small-caps
summary: BLS E-Services, Shankara Buildpro, Bansal Wire Industries, and JSW Dulux have announced stock splits set for October 2026. The corporate actions will adjust share counts and face values for shareholders. The underlying companies report varied financial growth amid rising input costs and market headwinds. Retail investors holding these stocks will see their share quantities adjusted according to the announced ratios on the record dates.
whats_next: October 2026 record dates for the respective stock splits
why_it_matters: Share holdings multiply automatically without changing total investment value.
